name: What are common mistakes to avoid when investing in luxury real estate?

mainEntity.name: What are common mistakes to avoid when investing in luxury real estate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common mistakes include underestimating ongoing costs like property taxes and maintenance, overlooking the importance of a detailed property inspection, and not thoroughly vetting local rental market demand. Another pitfall is failing to secure adequate insurance for high-value assets or neglecting to consult with tax professionals regarding potential implications. Making informed decisions requires comprehensive research and expert guidance to mitigate these risks and ensure a sound investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid underestimating costs, skipping detailed inspections, ignoring market demand, lacking proper insurance, and not consulting tax professionals.
